'''Blood on the Flowers Flightknife''' was a unit of [[Adumari]] [[Blade-32 superiority fighter|Blade-32]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]], who challenged and lost to the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] flight visiting their world. Only one badly-wounded [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] managed to survive the duel by ejecting from his stricken craft.
